items.followUp: Write an algorithm for brushing your teeth.

rubric.why: The algorithm must include putting on socks and shoes for both feet.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for including both socks and both shoes.

rubric.why: A simple algorithm has a beginning and an end, and socks are worn before shoes.
rubric.description: Shows the start, the order of the actions, and the stop.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for showing a start and stop, with socks before shoes.

modelAnswer: Put on the left sock, then the right sock.
Put on the left shoe, then the right shoe.

items.followUp: Convert (101101)₂ into the decimal number system.

rubric.why: The binary digits are evaluated using their powers-of-2 place values.
rubric.description: Shows the correct place-value expansion or its evaluated place values.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct expansion or equivalent place-value calculation.
Award 1 mark for the correct answer, 23.
